reels.title: U-Space: Uncovering When and Why Uncertainty Arises in Language Models

editorial_notes.reasoning: Mechanistic interpretability has a massive 1.55x velocity multiplier; explaining 'uncertainty' in LLMs as a 'flickering bulb' circuit is perfect for 3b1b-style physics-based animations.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Ever wonder if your AI is lying, or just genuinely confused?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A dimmer switch on a lightbulb that flickers right before the filament burns out.
